shots.line: Nobody can wake up in their younger body.
Your memories aren’t stored like videos.
Every time you remember something, your brain rebuilds it, and it can change a little.
The part of the brain behind self-control really does keep developing into your mid-twenties.
And in 1995, psychologists Thomas Gilovich and Victoria Medvec published research on regret.
Over the long run, people regret what they didn’t do more than what they did.
So if you could go back... what’s the one thing you’d fix?
